{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Momentum and Quality", 
"mechanism": "The combination of momentum and quality predictors should outperform due to the interaction between market trends and firm fundamentals.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "PS"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Value and Leverage", 
"mechanism": "The combination of value and leverage predictors should outperform due to the contrast between underpriced firms and overleveraged ones.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Profitability and Investment", 
"mechanism": "The combination of profitability and investment predictors should outperform due to the interaction between firm efficiency and growth potential.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "ROE"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "InvGrowth"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Momentum and Earnings", 
"mechanism": "The combination of momentum and earnings predictors should outperform due to the contrast between market trends and firm profitability.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "EP"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Quality and Leverage", 
"mechanism": "The combination of quality and leverage predictors should outperform due to the interaction between firm fundamentals and financial stability.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Value and Profitability", 
"mechanism": "The combination of value and profitability predictors should outperform due to the contrast between underpriced firms and efficient ones.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "ROE"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Investment and Earnings", 
"mechanism": "The combination of investment and earnings predictors should outperform due to the interaction between firm growth potential and profitability.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "InvGrowth"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "EP"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Momentum and Quality with Leverage", 
"mechanism": "The combination of momentum, quality, and leverage predictors should outperform due to the interaction between market trends, firm fundamentals, and financial stability.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": 0.3, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": -0.2, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36}
]}
